dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "Whether you're a weary traveler or a seasoned returning guest, the Masters of the Night-Wind bid you welcome."

dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "May you run and not stumble. May you walk in the night and not get lost. These words are just words, but words have the power to save or destroy, so please, speak freely."

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Continue Reading

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Leave

dialogues.speaker: Hornshroom Augury Ad
dialogues.text: "O visitor from afar, have your eyes grown dim? Have you lost your way? Come into the Hornshroom Augury, and I will lead you to your answer."

dialogues.speaker: Silken Handwriting
dialogues.text: "Master Chicomexochitl, I am a merchant from Fontaine. I would like to ask you: Where should I go to find personal happiness?"

dialogues.speaker: Hornshroom Augury
dialogues.text: "Chase not a vague remoteness, but stop and gaze around you. Happiness may be found there, glimmering brightly like gold."

dialogues.speaker: Silken Handwriting
dialogues.text: "Thank you so much, Master Chicomexochitl. I understand now — the Mora gleaming in my pocket here is the source of my happiness! Indeed, it was right beside me all along..."

dialogues.speaker: Hornshroom Augury
dialogues.text: "Even though any normal person could see that's not the point I'm trying to make... I'm still glad that you're happy."

dialogues.speaker: Silken Handwriting
dialogues.text: "Master Chicome, it's me again. I'm a merchant from Fontaine, but I never feel like I have enough Mora. How can I get more Mora than I can spend?"

dialogues.speaker: Hornshroom Augury
dialogues.text: "As the ancient sages say, be ye not the Saurian who lusts after unrighteous wealth... (The subsequent text has been randomly crossed out)."

dialogues.speaker: Hornshroom Augury
dialogues.text: "No, wait! I'm a fortune-teller. What do you take me for, an investment bank? Could you please be a little more down-to-earth here?"

dialogues.speaker: Silken Handwriting
dialogues.text: "Earth, eh... I see, I see. What you're saying is that I should invest in geological and mining ventures, yes? I get it now."

dialogues.speaker: Hornshroom Augury
dialogues.text: "Hang on. I never said that! Don't take me so literally each time!"

dialogues.speaker: Silken Handwriting
dialogues.text: "I'm here to keep my promise! Thank you so much, Master Chicome! I made a mint this time — you truly are a most efficacious sage! I'll be back with more earnest inquiries for sure!"

dialogues.speaker: Graffiti Alliance Announcement
dialogues.text: "Whether they be ideas that come to you while meditating or motifs read in the Sacred Flame, they must be witnessed by the world!"

dialogues.speaker: Graffiti Alliance Announcement
dialogues.text: "Break these conventions of silence! Shatter this dull atmosphere! Pick up your spray can and let the mountains and the people of the world hear your voice. Let them see your colors, and let them know your choices!"

dialogues.speaker: Graffiti Alliance Announcement
dialogues.text: "Become the voice of avant-garde. Join the Graffiti Alliance today!"

dialogues.speaker: Graffiti Alliance Announcement
dialogues.text: "Despite painting being a form of sorcery in and of itself, imaginative thinking will be very well-received — but all the same, take care to avoid those most sacred of places."

dialogues.speaker: Idukan's Trove Advert
dialogues.text: "Welcome to Idukan's Trove. This month's new stock: 'The Case Files of Miss Orith: Night on Cider Lake' and 'Mirage Warriors Special Collection: Volume VII'."

dialogues.speaker: Idukan's Trove Advert
dialogues.text: "If we don't have the book you want in stock, please place an order with us. It's alright if you don't know the book's precise name. We'll be happy to help you find it."

dialogues.speaker: Idukan's Trove Advert
dialogues.text: "We hope reading books can bring you happiness, and may their wisdom keep you from going astray."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Praise Master Ixim! The phlogiston pattern you drew is incredible. I've finally become popular! As soon as I got back to Fontaine, lots of people thronged around me!"

dialogues.speaker: Ixim's Message
dialogues.text: "Err, thank you very much for the compliment. But I don't recall drawing you anything like that. Are you sure this is connected to me?

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Why, of course, it's related to you — as soon as I got off the aquabus, I disrobed and displayed the pattern you drew to all. Forget humans — even the Gardemeks started chasing after me!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Good thing I'm a fast runner and didn't let them take advantage of me! *sigh* Seems like being famous is a real hassle, too..."

dialogues.speaker: Ixim's Message
dialogues.text: "That's... How should I put this? I think this has nothing at all to do with the phlogiston pattern, and in any case, you really shouldn't be taking your clothes off in public spaces..."

dialogues.speaker: Tourist Message Board
dialogues.text: "As the ancient sages say, every mystery comes at a price. Can medicine cure all maladies? Can fortune-telling ameliorate all disasters?

dialogues.speaker: Tourist Message Board
dialogues.text: "Do not touch secrets that you cannot overcome by your abilities."

dialogues.speaker: Tourist Message Board
dialogues.text: "Guests from beyond the night-wind, remember not to ask about taboo mysteries, lest you court disaster."

dialogues.speaker: Tourist Message Board
dialogues.text: "When asking questions, be wary of making rash decisions, lest you come to regret a wrong move too late."

dialogues.speaker: Full 3-Page Long Guarantee
dialogues.text: "I, Samil, am well aware that touching the feathers of a meditating Iktomisaurus without permission is a serious offense indeed..."

dialogues.speaker: Full 3-Page Long Guarantee
dialogues.text: "...I hope everyone learns from my experience, and will not fiddle with the wings of Saurian whelp out of curiosity — and definitely not try to feed them any Jueyun Chilis..."

dialogues.speaker: Full 3-Page Long Guarantee
dialogues.text: "...Thank you, Elder Tlapopoctiztetl, for not minding my behavior and for not having me expelled..."

dialogues.speaker: Tepano's Message
dialogues.text: "And please everybody: Do not disturb Saurian whelps while they rest. Nor should you touch them willy-nilly, like Mr. Samil did."

dialogues.speaker: Tepano's Message
dialogues.text: "If you want to learn more about saurian whelp habits, you can ask Explorer Ororon."

dialogues.speaker: Tepano's Message
dialogues.text: "Also: Ororon is just really into his herbal medicine research. He is not a greengrocer."

dialogues.speaker: Claricia's Message
dialogues.text: "Hello everyone! I'm a traveling painter from Mondstadt. Does anyone have any paint recommendations — you know, the kind that gives that gilded golden finish... I hear it's called phlogiston or something?"

dialogues.speaker: Someone's Message
dialogues.text: "Phlogiston engraving, eh... It's not enough to have the paint for that. There's also a special brush you'll need to buy. I personally recommend a brush made of Qucusaurus feathers. It's durable and cheap."

dialogues.speaker: Claricia's Message
dialogues.text: "Okay! I'll go get a brush!"

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "Just buying a brush isn't enough either. What are you going to use to store the phlogiston? This stuff won't last very long without a receptacle..."

dialogues.speaker: Someone's Message
dialogues.text: "That's a good point. The palette will also need to be crafted from special materials..."

dialogues.speaker: Claricia's Message
dialogues.text: "Okay, thank you, everyone! I bought all the stuff. So... What about the paint? What kind of paint should I buy?
